Macro Split Calculator

Split your daily calories into protein, carb and fat targets in grams, calories and percentages for your goal.

MacroGramsCalories% of calories
Protein–––
Fat–––
Carbs–––

Guideline only — protein 2.0–2.2 g/kg, fat 25% of calories, carbs fill the remainder. Not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your daily calorie target.
  2. Enter your body weight in kg.
  3. Choose your goal: cut, maintain or bulk.
  4. Read your protein, fat and carb targets in grams, kcal and %.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the macros calculated?

Protein is set from your body weight (2.2 g/kg when cutting, 2.0 g/kg otherwise), fat gets 25% of calories, and the remaining calories go to carbs.

Why is protein higher when cutting?

Higher protein while cutting helps preserve muscle in a calorie deficit. When maintaining or bulking, 2.0 g/kg is a widely used guideline.

Is this the right split for everyone?

It is a common starting split for general fitness goals. Athletes, medical conditions or strict diets (e.g. keto) need a customized plan from a professional.
